comment: The drivers of daasiot-android for each <target>/<linkage> of android_daas/libdaas.lock.json: the generic ones of the libdaas package ("<id> <version>") and the specialized ones of android-drivers_sdk ("<id> <version> <adapters>"). Update it when a driver version changes (e.g. ble/ble_version.hpp) or a target is added.
